name: Margarita Bermejo Cano
headline: People Science & Analytics
specialisms: AI Adoption Research · Customer Insights · Workforce Measurement
summary: People science and analytics professional with a career spanning HR operations, regional workforce insight and customer-facing research. At Microsoft, I lead analytical work on AI readiness and human–agent teaming and co-authored the full 2025 Agentic Teaming & Trust Research Report. Previously, I delivered engagement-driver and attrition-risk analyses at LinkedIn Glint, supported leaders across 25 EMEA countries and led shared-services customer-satisfaction measurement at MetLife. I connect reliable survey measurement and predictive analysis with practical recommendations for customers, product teams and workforce decisions.
heroIntro: I turn employee feedback, customer evidence and workforce data into clear recommendations. My work spans AI adoption research at Microsoft, customer-facing people analytics at LinkedIn Glint and international measurement programmes at MetLife.

projects.title: Agentic AI readiness, teaming & trust
projects.summary: Lead analyst on an enterprise research programme and co-author of the full four-chapter public report.
projects.question: What evidence helps organisations understand readiness for and adoption of agentic ways of working?
projects.contribution: Led the analytical work across an in-depth report series, using exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis, regression, comparative analysis and descriptive methods.
projects.outcome: Delivered the analytical report series and co-authored the full 2025 Agentic Teaming & Trust Research Report. The published study surveyed 1,800 full-time employees across nine markets.

projects.title: Engagement drivers and attrition risk
projects.summary: Customer-facing analytical work connecting employee feedback, disengagement and retention.
projects.question: Which engagement signals are associated with disengagement and attrition risk?
projects.contribution: Linked survey and behavioural data, modelled disengagement and attrition risk, and used relative-risk and key-driver analyses to explain findings to customer-facing teams and senior stakeholders.
projects.outcome: Delivered customer recommendations on engagement priorities and retention risk, translating statistical findings into practical workforce discussions.

projects.title: Organisational AI-readiness measurement
projects.summary: Analytical leadership on AI readiness measurement and the factors associated with it.
projects.question: Are we measuring organisational AI readiness reliably, and what factors are associated with it?
projects.contribution: Tested the instrument's structure and reliability using EFA, CFA and item analysis; examined factors associated with readiness using regression, correlation and relative weight analysis.
projects.outcome: Delivered measurement-structure, reliability and relationship analyses referenced in The State of AI Change Readiness eBook.

projects.title: EMEA HR shared-services satisfaction
projects.summary: Full-lifecycle ownership of a regional customer-satisfaction survey.
projects.question: How can a regional HR service understand the experience it provides?
projects.contribution: Led requirements and survey design, implementation, analysis and reporting for the EMEA HR Shared Services customer-satisfaction programme.
projects.outcome: Delivered a consistent regional measurement approach and recommendations to support service-improvement priorities.

projects.title: Early AI-assistant adoption research
projects.summary: From the first findings report to a sustained enterprise AI survey-reporting cycle.
projects.question: What do early users tell us about adopting an enterprise AI assistant?
projects.contribution: Co-produced the first findings report as one of two analysts, then sustained recurring survey analysis and reporting with digital-experience and future-of-work researchers.
projects.outcome: Findings featured in a public workplace-research report and were cited at the company's annual conference. Maintained recurring and quarterly reporting for the early-access programme.

projects.title: Post-migration customer-experience study
projects.summary: Lead analytical work on a customer-experience survey following a product migration.
projects.question: How did customers experience the migration, and which themes should product teams prioritise?
projects.contribution: Analysed customer-segment scores, satisfaction drivers and correlations, translating results into clear priorities for the teams responsible for the experience.
projects.outcome: Translated customer feedback into prioritised, actionable recommendations for the teams responsible for the experience.

projects.title: EMEA employee-exit measurement
projects.summary: Regional delivery of a standardised exit-survey programme.
projects.question: How can regional teams build comparable evidence about why employees leave?
projects.contribution: Delivered the EMEA component of the Global Exit Survey programme, supporting a standardised approach to collecting and analysing employee-exit feedback.
projects.outcome: Developed a consistent regional evidence base on attrition drivers for workforce reporting and stakeholder discussions.

projects.title: Repeat-caller and first-call-resolution analysis
projects.summary: Behavioural profiling to understand repeat calls to an HR shared-services team.
projects.question: What distinguishes repeat callers, and which service actions should be considered?
projects.contribution: Built a model to identify repeat-caller profiles as part of a first-call-resolution analysis and used the findings to recommend targeted actions.
projects.outcome: Delivered repeat-caller profiling and bespoke recommendations for the HR service.
